text: 44-year-old male. The patient's daughter reports a 1-week history of right leg weakness, unsteady gait, and multiple falls. text: Given the classic triad of urinary incontinence, cognitive decline, and gait disturbance, I suspect Normal Pressure Hydrocephalus. REQUEST TEST: MRI of the brain.
